name: Mandate
description:
Base executable document type for guaranteed authority delegation.

The actor bound to authorityHolderChannel controls the authority or resource
being delegated. The actor bound to authorizedActorChannel receives the
delegated authority. The actor bound to mandateGuarantorChannel confirms that
the declared authority relationship is legitimate and may terminate the
mandate.

Authority confirmation and activation are separate lifecycle facts.
Confirmation records that the guarantor accepted the authority declaration.
Activation records the timestamp from which the authorized actor may use the
delegated authority.

By default, successful authority confirmation emits Mandate/Mandate
Activated for the inherited activation workflow to apply. A mandate may set
activateOnAuthorityConfirmation to false and define an additional operation
that emits Mandate/Mandate Activated when a later condition is satisfied.

The base type defines and implements initialization, authority confirmation,
activation, termination, lifecycle event emission, lifecycle transition
guards, and graceful mandate-document termination. Subtypes inherit these
lifecycle implementations unchanged. They may add specialized fields,
validation, participants, embedded documents, and operations that emit the
standard activation or termination Messages.

mandateGuarantorChannel.description:
Required participant channel whose actor is the mandate guarantor.

The guarantor confirms that the declared authority relationship is
legitimate and may invoke the standard termination operation.

authorityHolderChannel.description:
Required participant channel whose actor controls the authority or
resource delegated by this mandate. The authority holder may invoke the
standard termination operation.

authorizedActorChannel.description:
Required participant channel whose actor receives the delegated
authority. Concrete mandate subtypes define the delegated resource,
action, target, or request semantics.

mandateTerminationChannel.description:
Composite channel through which either the guarantor or authority holder
may invoke terminateMandate. When one entry is eligible through both
members, the composite produces one logical delivery.

mandateLifecycleChannel.description:
Processor-managed lifecycle channel used by the inherited initialization
workflow.

mandateActivatedChannel.description:
Internal triggered-event channel routing Mandate/Mandate Activated
Messages emitted by confirmation or specialized mandate operations.
External Timeline Entries do not enter this channel directly.

mandateTerminatedChannel.description:
Internal triggered-event channel routing Mandate/Mandate Terminated
Messages emitted by the standard termination operation or specialized
mandate operations.

mandateLifecycleDefinition.description:
Canonical reusable BEX implementation of mandate lifecycle transitions.
It contains deterministic functions used by initializeMandate,
confirmMandateAuthority, applyMandateActivation, and
applyMandateTermination. Subtypes do not replace these functions.

inResponseTo.description: Exact Message answered by this lifecycle Message.

request.description: Operation request payload, including any optional reason.

then.value: validation.function.functions must declare the entry named by validation.function.entry.

initializeMandate.description:
Inherited initialization implementation.

Normal Blue type resolution and bootstrap validate required role-channel
bindings and lifecycle configuration. When validation.function.entry is
present, this workflow verifies that validation.function.functions
declares the selected local function.

On success it materializes activateOnAuthorityConfirmation as true when
absent and sets status to Coordination/Status Pending.

On failure it sets status to Coordination/Status Failed, stores the
first deterministic failure in initializationError.

Initialization does not write, clear, or normalize lifecycle timestamps.

Concrete workflow steps and BEX implementation are defined in this base
type.

confirmMandateAuthority.description:
Inherited operation through which the guarantor confirms that the
declared authority relationship is legitimate.

On Coordination/Status Pending it changes status to
Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed, records authorityConfirmedAt
from the root causal Timeline Entry, emits Mandate/Mandate Authority
Confirmed, and, when activateOnAuthorityConfirmation is not false, emits
Mandate/Mandate Activated for the inherited activation workflow.

On Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed, Mandate/Status Active,
Mandate/Status Terminated, or Coordination/Status Failed it performs no
lifecycle mutation and does not replace authorityConfirmedAt.

A guarantor may choose to use Operation Request.document and
requireExactDocumentVersion to pin the reviewed mandate state. This base
operation does not require or enforce that choice.

Concrete workflow steps and BEX implementation are defined in this base
type.

applyMandateActivation.description:
Sole authoritative mandate-activation implementation.

It accepts Mandate/Mandate Activated emitted by an operation. On
Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed it changes status to Mandate/Status
Active and records activatedAt from the root causal Timeline Entry. The
Message itself does not supply the timestamp and is not emitted again.

On Coordination/Status Pending, Mandate/Status Active,
Mandate/Status Terminated, or Coordination/Status Failed it performs no
lifecycle mutation and does not replace activatedAt.

A Message without a root causal Timeline Entry cannot establish an
activation timestamp and must not activate the mandate.

Concrete workflow steps and BEX implementation are defined in this base
type.

terminateMandate.description:
Standard termination operation available to the guarantor and authority
holder.

Unless the mandate is already Mandate/Status Terminated, it emits
Mandate/Mandate Terminated with the optional request reason and
correlation to the invoking Message. This includes a failed mandate,
allowing the guarantor or authority holder to stop its processing. The
operation does not write lifecycle state directly;
applyMandateTermination remains the sole authoritative termination
implementation.

On Mandate/Status Terminated it emits no lifecycle Message. Specialized
mandate types may add other operations that emit Mandate/Mandate
Terminated.

Concrete workflow steps are defined in this base type.

reason.description: Optional human-readable or machine-generated termination reason.

applyMandateTermination.description:
Sole authoritative mandate-termination implementation.

It accepts Mandate/Mandate Terminated emitted by an operation. On
Coordination/Status Pending, Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed, or
Mandate/Status Active it changes status to Mandate/Status Terminated and
records terminatedAt from the root causal Timeline Entry. The Message
itself carries any reason and correlation, does not supply the timestamp,
and is not emitted again.

The Compute result requests graceful termination after its state changes
and emitted events have been buffered. Coordination validates the complete
result before applying effects, then applies changes, emits events, and
requests graceful termination in that order.

On Mandate/Status Terminated or Coordination/Status Failed it performs no
lifecycle mutation and does not replace terminatedAt. Receipt of the
termination Message still requests graceful processing termination, so a
failed mandate can be stopped without replacing its failure state.

Concrete workflow steps and BEX implementation are defined in this base
type. No dedicated termination workflow-step type is required.

status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the mandate.

Initialization sets exactly one initial status:

- Coordination/Status Pending when deterministic initialization succeeds.
- Coordination/Status Failed when deterministic initialization fails.

Supported transitions are:

- Coordination/Status Pending -> Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed
- Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed -> Mandate/Status Active
- Coordination/Status Pending -> Mandate/Status Terminated
- Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed -> Mandate/Status Terminated
- Mandate/Status Active -> Mandate/Status Terminated

Coordination/Status Failed and Mandate/Status Terminated are terminal.
Lifecycle workflows do not replace timestamps or statuses after the
corresponding transition succeeds.

initializationError.description:
First deterministic initialization error when status is
Coordination/Status Failed.

Initialization writes this field only when initialization fails and stops
at the first material error rather than accumulating an error list. A
successful initialization does not write, clear, or normalize a value
already present in an authored document.

activateOnAuthorityConfirmation.description:
Controls whether successful authority confirmation also emits the mandate
activation Message.

When true, successful confirmation emits Mandate/Mandate Activated, which
is handled by the inherited activation workflow.

When false, successful confirmation leaves the mandate in
Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed. A specialized operation must later emit
Mandate/Mandate Activated.

When absent before initialization, the initialization workflow materializes
true. The field is not a fixed inherited value, so a concrete mandate may
explicitly set it to false.

authorityConfirmedAt.description:
Microsecond timestamp of the root causal Coordination/Timeline Entry that
successfully changed the mandate from Coordination/Status Pending to
Mandate/Status Authority Confirmed.

The value is derived by the inherited authority-confirmation workflow. It
is never supplied by the operation request. After authority confirmation
succeeds, inherited lifecycle workflows do not replace it.

activatedAt.description:
Microsecond timestamp from which the mandate entered Mandate/Status Active.

The value is derived by the inherited activation workflow from the root
causal Coordination/Timeline Entry that led to the accepted
Mandate/Mandate Activated Message. It is not supplied by that Message.
After activation succeeds, inherited lifecycle workflows do not replace
it.

terminatedAt.description:
Microsecond timestamp from which the mandate entered Mandate/Status Terminated.

The value is derived by the inherited termination workflow from the root
causal Coordination/Timeline Entry that led to the accepted
Mandate/Mandate Terminated Message. It is not supplied by that Message.
After termination succeeds, inherited lifecycle workflows do not replace
it.

validation.description:
Optional request-validation convention inherited by mandate subtypes.

A concrete mandate type defines which request or event is matched by
validation.request and which runtime component performs the validation.
Mandate/Operation Mandate matches the Operation Request payload.
Document-responder and MyOS mandate types may validate an entire request
Message.
